root.parent_catalog: Full immutable accepted predecessor, exact mass, source indices, observer provenance and canonical state digest; not a second live actor.
root.preparations: Every controlled formation event, every assembly and old adapter/projection, all material and resources.
root.cases: case -> variants -> producers -> paths plus exact unconditional metric means.

path.predecessor_ref: Key into independently reconstructed complete catalog.
path.probability: Exact Fraction string, unchanged from the predecessor; sums to one for every case/variant/producer.
path.runtime_trace: Ordered event and complete canonical state. Spelling adapters are allowed; paid/stopped events and physical values cannot be removed.
path.state: Same canonical schema as every trace state.
path.metrics: Every independent metric plus every advertised producer metric must be reconciled; no silent exclusions.

state.core: All keys of the actual inherited RI core, without projection loss.

native.phase: ready, own_paid, own_returned, recipient_paid, recipient_returned, own_read, recipient_read or settled

latches.capacity: Meters overwrite return bits. No concurrent return/shortfall runtime copy.

state.links: Two None or {id, sign} sockets; sign in -1,0,1; id 0/1 initially, 2 for replacement.
state.retired: Actual retired {id,sign} parts, never refunded or reused.
state.waste: Actual uncaptured final RI packet, if the miss/failure branch occurs.

observer.restriction: No observer coordinate may influence an operational guard or update. Transmission is computed combinationally for assessment; no future event reads its diagnostic copy.

lossless_parent_lens.replacement: Replace parent.parent.producer.core, the four producer physical fields and parent binding scope/permission/delivery. Every other byte-equivalent JSON value remains inherited. Full embedded-parent oracle and lens producer are equivalent only if all untouched fields agree.

representation_differences: The oracle keeps a full parent during execution and emits a catalog-plus-live-lens canonical state; neither representation duplicates spendable accounts.
The oracle stores diagnostics/outcome markers with each saved state but labels them observer-only and never uses them as update input.
The literal controller stops at count4 or count6, fixed by the declared continuation configuration. It never reads outcome-word length to make a learning decision.
Training completion is a derived count/phase boundary in the oracle; an explicit producer close marker may be aligned only if it changes no operational field and creates no unbacked memory.
Different bill/event field names may be bijectively renamed after format inspection; no semantic transition repair may be hidden in an adapter.
exclusions: No producer transition import, no new stochastic formation mass, no independent efficacy calibration, no indefinite learning claim, no Python-to-Lean refinement claim.
execution_gate: Root protocol freeze plus separately hash-frozen independent source/schema; preserve checkpoint draft and every substantive failed first run.
